name: pitchfork-daemons
title: Pitchfork Daemons
description: Start, stop and restart Pitchfork daemons, read their logs, open their URLs and see them in the menu bar. Needs the Pitchfork CLI.
author: dieter_luypaert

commands.name: daemons
commands.title: Search Daemons
commands.subtitle: Pitchfork
commands.description: List every Pitchfork daemon by namespace, and start, stop, restart or read the logs of any of them.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Running Daemons
commands.subtitle: Pitchfork
commands.description: Show how many Pitchfork daemons run in the menu bar, with start, stop and open for each.

preferences.name: binary
preferences.title: Pitchfork Binary
preferences.description: Absolute path to pitchfork. Leave empty to look in the mise, Homebrew, Cargo and ~/.local/bin locations.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
